content.comment_body: Good morning, We have a travelling saw that only operates as expected when a laptop is connected to the [product_name] PLC. Using the online monitoring feature, the saw functions normally. However, when attempting to start the saw without the laptop, one part of the cycle (the saw moving upwards with a pneumatic cylinder) does not occur. Electrically, everything appears correct. Thanks.

Could you clarify your statement: "But whenever the saw is started without,"? Are you referring to starting the saw without the online monitoring feature enabled? This function should not affect how the program runs.

Hello, Yes, when the saw is started without the PC connected and monitoring in online mode, it does not work correctly. If online monitoring is only for observing, as I suspect, then perhaps this behavior is just a coincidence? However, in repeated tests—at least ten times—with and without the PC connected, the issue consistently occurs.

I can't determine the error without seeing your code; I don't have enough information and can only offer general advice. I'm certain that the online monitoring feature is not the cause. Could you upload your program so we may review it?
This may sound trivial, but have you tried powering off the machine and [product_name] PLC, then turning them back on after disconnecting the PC?
Good morning, Yes, the system has been powered off between tests. Thanks.
Good morning, Are you referring to a video upload feature? Or is there an option to upload your program as a file? Thanks.
If possible, include both—a video and your [product_name] program file, attached together in a zip file.

analysis.insight_summary: A user has noticed inconsistent operation of machinery managed by a [product_name] PLC—specifically, a travel motion fails when the PC is not connected in online mode. While all electrical systems have been checked, this unexplained issue is causing uncertainty, suggesting some perceived dependency on the PC connection for proper operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the machine to operate consistently and autonomously, regardless of PC connection or monitoring status, since the [product_name] PLC should directly control the programmed functions.
